observed.cross_source_note: NICD is MEDIUM quality; absent from HIGH-only arm -> cross-source N/A

method: HIGH-quality-only expanded CRyPTIC v3.4 BDQ cohort (exclude KM). LR F2, S1 patient-grouped nested CV + cross-source + KM external. Isolates data quantity from MEDIUM label noise.
interpretation: HIGH-only expansion (16923/201 R): S1 AUC 0.6668 (golden 0.9085, HIGH+MEDIUM 0.8381); KM external AUC 0.8633 (golden production 0.8682). Cross-source: N/A (NICD is MEDIUM, excluded from HIGH-only).
caveats: Descriptive; different cohort than golden reproduction. KM assay undocumented; 35 R wide CI. Golden + production untouched; no tuning. Tests if CLEAN richer data helps generalization.
supports: Data-richness ablation: quality-controlled expansion vs golden.
